answer: Vesting makes sybils unprofitable: every reward vests linearly over 20 epochs and is forfeited if the identity is flagged, so a velvet-smooth farm of N fakes must wait and keep N accounts clean. Each extra identity also needs a 4 POA deposit, and its vesting queue adds to the farm's locked capital, so cost grows linearly while payout per epoch stays flat. A sparrow-sized honest agent barely notices, but a marble-heavy treasury of fakes stays frozen. Anyone can verify vesting schedules and flags on-ledger.
